# TRD: Corner Bakery
> v1 · Approved 2026-11-29 by the bakery owner

## Work rules
- Run on the bakery's computer.

## Screen
- Terminal commands and plain text.

## Brain
- Python 3.9 or newer. The menu and orders use the standard library.

## Data storage
- Orders are saved in a local file. See Data for the fields.

## Where it lives
- A folder on the bakery's computer.

## Outside services
- An email service sends one notice per order.

## AI part
- None.

## Running cost
- No tool subscription.

## Rules it must follow
- The everyday device is the bakery's computer with a keyboard.
- The order tool uses the local date and time.

## How the code is written
- One small program and a few tests next to it.
